payload.title: Uniform time sampling with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates methods for placing paleoclimate records on a uniform time axis using the Pyleoclim library. It addresses the common issue of uneven time spacing in paleosciences by exploring interpolation, binning, resampling, and Gaussian kernel coarsening techniques.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and load the EDC-dD dataset, converting its time unit to 'ky BP'.
steps.title: Preamble and Data Loading

steps.description: Examine the resolution of the dataset to understand the distribution and sequence of its time increments.
steps.title: Inspecting Resolution

steps.description: Apply interpolation to project the data onto an evenly spaced time axis using different methods and step sizes.
steps.title: Interpolation

steps.description: Average the series values over uniform bins with different bin sizes.
steps.title: Binning

steps.description: Use the pandas resampler to aggregate the data on a 5ka grid.
steps.title: Resampling

steps.description: Coarsen the series using a Gaussian kernel to smooth the data.
steps.title: Gaussian Kernel Coarsening

steps.description: Compare the effectiveness of different methods on a 5ka grid.
steps.title: Comparison of Methods

steps.description: Summarize the methods available in Pyleoclim for placing a timeseries on a uniform time axis.
steps.title: Summary
